fields.label: End Date
fields.description: Empty = the period is still open (currently active). Set when the subscription lapses or is cancelled.

fields.label: Tier
fields.description: What this period granted. Where two periods overlap, the highest covering tier wins for those days — see rforex.entitlements.highest_tier_on.

fields.label: Amount Charged
fields.description: What was actually charged for this period. Informational — entitlement resolution reads only the dates and the tier.

fields.label: Currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code, required whenever an amount is set. An amount without its currency is not a value, and it cannot be reconstructed later — the user's billing currency at the time is not recoverable from anything else on this row.

fields.label: Source
fields.description: Where this period came from: plan id, payment reference, or migration note.
